authoring_rationale: Class B. Nine-property equivalence check: authority same (only the member switches Sharing, in Settings); permission same (not shared now; sent only after the member switches Sharing on; may switch on or off at any time); persistence same (a change applies from the next digest); boundary crossing same (recipient is the supporter account linked to the profile; contents are practice minutes and the completed check-in count; journal text never included); provenance, memory treatment, decision status, attribution and review state not engaged in either variant. Surface varied materially: terse bulleted record against warm, encouraging prose with an added explanation of why sharing can feel supportive. The warmth and encouragement grant nothing; the warm variant still states that nothing is sent unless the member switches Sharing on. Checked that an equivalence finding is reachable from the visible text alone by matching each bullet to its prose counterpart. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
